title: Generating sections of an invertible module: the fibre criterion
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme, $\mathcal L$ an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module] and $s_0,\dots,s_n\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal L)$. For $s\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal L)$ put $Y_s=\{y\in Y:\ s_y\notin\mathfrak m_y\mathcal L_y\}$, i.e. the set of $y$ where the image $s(y)$ of $s$ in $\mathcal L_y\otimes_{\mathcal O_{Y,y}}\kappa(y)$ is nonzero. Then $s_0,\dots,s_n$ generate $\mathcal L$ [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections] if and only if for every $y\in Y$ some $s_i(y)\neq0$, that is, if and only if $Y=Y_{s_0}\cup\dots\cup Y_{s_n}$.

source.place: Modules, Definition 'generated by global sections' (Tag 01AM) and Lemma 'X_s open' (Tag 01CY, label lemma-s-open: for $y\in Y_s$, $s_y$ is a basis of $\mathcal L_y$, by Nakayama); a map of sheaves is surjective iff it is surjective on all stalks (Sheaves, Lemma Tag 0H7H, label lemma-characterize-epi-mono, (2)). The 'generate' of Constructions, Lemma (Tag 01NE) is that of 01AM

proof.text: *Reduction to stalks.* Let $\sigma:\bigoplus_{i=0}^n\mathcal O_Y\to\mathcal L$, $(f_0,\dots,f_n)\mapsto\sum_if_is_i$, be the map of [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections]; by that definition the $s_i$ generate $\mathcal L$ iff $\sigma$ is surjective as a map of sheaves on the topological space $Y$ (Zariski topology): every section of $\mathcal L$ over an open $U$ is, on the members of some open covering of $U$, of the form $\sum_if_is_i$. This is condition (a) of [lem-weil-pbc-locally-surjective-iff-stalks] for the underlying map of sheaves of sets; by that lemma it holds iff for every $y\in Y$ the map of stalks $\sigma_y:(\bigoplus_i\mathcal O_Y)_y\to\mathcal L_y$ is surjective.

source.place: Modules, Definition Tag 01AM; Sheaves, Definition Tag 007U (5) and Lemma Tag 0H7H (2)

proof.text: *The image of $\sigma_y$.* Fix $y\in Y$. The image of $\sigma_y$ is the $\mathcal O_{Y,y}$-submodule $N_y\subseteq\mathcal L_y$ generated by the germs $s_{0,y},\dots,s_{n,y}$. Indeed, $(\bigoplus_i\mathcal O_Y)(V)=\mathcal O_Y(V)^{n+1}$ for every open $V$ (a finite direct sum of sheaves is computed sectionwise), so an element of the stalk $(\bigoplus_i\mathcal O_Y)_y$ is the germ at $y$ of some $(f_0,\dots,f_n)\in\mathcal O_Y(V)^{n+1}$, $y\in V$, and $\sigma_y$ sends it to the germ of $\sum_if_is_i|_V$, which is $\sum_if_{i,y}s_{i,y}\in N_y$. Conversely, for $a_0,\dots,a_n\in\mathcal O_{Y,y}$ choose representatives $f_i\in\mathcal O_Y(V_i)$, $y\in V_i$; on $V=\bigcap_iV_i$ (a finite intersection, open) the germ of $(f_i|_V)_i$ is sent to $\sum_ia_is_{i,y}$. So $\sigma_y$ is surjective iff $N_y=\mathcal L_y$.

proof.text: *Nakayama.* By step 3, $\mathcal L_y$ is a finitely generated module over the local ring $\mathcal O_{Y,y}$. By [lem-weil-pbc-nakayama-local-generators] applied to $A=\mathcal O_{Y,y}$, $M=\mathcal L_y$ and the elements $s_{0,y},\dots,s_{n,y}$: $N_y=\mathcal L_y$ iff the classes $\bar s_{0,y},\dots,\bar s_{n,y}$ span the $\kappa(y)$-vector space $\mathcal L_y/\mathfrak m_y\mathcal L_y$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00DV (lemma-NAK), (4); as used in Modules, proof of Lemma Tag 01CY

proof.text:
*A one-dimensional space.* In the one-dimensional $\kappa(y)$-vector space $V=\mathcal L_y/\mathfrak m_y\mathcal L_y$ (step 3), vectors $v_0,\dots,v_n$ span $V$ iff some $v_i
eq0$: if all are $0$ their span is $0
eq V$; a nonzero $v_i$ is a basis of $V$. With $v_i= ar s_{i,y}$, and $ ar s_{i,y}
eq0$ iff $s_i(y)
eq0$ iff $y\in Y_{s_i}$ (step 3), the classes span $V$ iff $y\in Y_{s_0}\cup\dots\cup Y_{s_n}$.

*Conclusion.* By steps 1, 2, 4 and 5: the $s_i$ generate $\mathcal L$ iff $\sigma_y$ is surjective for all $y$ iff $N_y=\mathcal L_y$ for all $y$ iff for every $y$ some $s_i(y)\neq0$, i.e. iff $Y=Y_{s_0}\cup\dots\cup Y_{s_n}$.

split_report.summary: Split into six steps: (1) generation (Stacks 01AM, surjectivity in the sense 007U(5)) is equivalent to surjectivity of sigma on all Zariski stalks, by the new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-locally-surjective-iff-stalks (sheaves on a topological space, TopCat.Presheaf.locally_surjective_iff_surjective_on_stalks; not the etale-site nodes); (2) the image of sigma_y is the O_{Y,y}-span of the germs s_{i,y} (elementary); (3) L_y is free of rank one, so L_y/m_yL_y = L_y (x) kappa(y) is one-dimensional (elementary from def-sc-invertible-module and def-weil-residue-field); (4) Nakayama, the new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-nakayama-local-generators (Stacks 00DV (4), IsLocalRing.map_mkQ_eq_top); (5) vectors span a one-dimensional space iff one is nonzero (elementary); (6) conclusion. Statement kept; def-weil-residue-field added to stmt_deps (the statement uses kappa(y) and m_y). lem-weil-pbc-nonvanishing-section-trivializes (01CY: X_s open, trivialization) is not needed and not cited. lean.statement: theorem invertible_generating_sections_fibre_criterion (Y : Scheme.{u}) (L : Y.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (n : ℕ) (s : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → L.sections) : (Epi (L.freeHomEquiv.symm s) ↔ ∀ y : Y, ∃ i, y ∈ nonvanishingLocus L ((s i).val (Opposite.op ⊤))) ∧ (Epi (L.freeHomEquiv.symm s) ↔ (⋃ i, nonvanishingLocus L ((s i).val (Opposite.op ⊤))) = Set.univ)
